name: BB-K8
description: BB-K8 was a black-plated BB-series astromech droid in the service of the First Order. The droid accompanied Captain Phasma and TN-3465 on their hunt for Lieutenant Sol Rivas. While on Luprora, BB-K8 was carried on the back on TN-3465 for part of the mission. The droid also helped TN-3465 to communicate with the Lupr'or. After Phasma killed Rivas, she also disintegrated BB-K8 and killed TN-3465 to cover up her role in the destruction of Starkiller Base.
